description: Requirements 01 and 02, which must be reconciled together. Requirement 02 says REMOVE the place card on the left side (future expansion is a LATER task - do NOT build it now). Requirement 01 changes the pill so it carries ONLY the numeric pill number (no accompanying text word) plus the provided referee-style SVG, on a lime pill background, and the photo associated with the pill number uses that same lime pill background. In the shipped code there is NO numbered pill on the left column (.vl-live-left is the stacked content blocks). The only element that is both a lime pill AND carries a number is .vl-live-photo-count inside the map preview card (.vl-live-map-preview), which today renders the text '{n} photos'. So: (a) the 'place card' to remove is .vl-live-map-preview (the absolutely-positioned card overlaid on the map at top:80px right:16px); and (b) the pill that must become number-only + referee SVG on lime is .vl-live-photo-count, which lives on the photo rail. Because 02 removes the entire .vl-live-map-preview card (which currently CONTAINS the photo rail and its .vl-live-photo-count pill), the pill must be relocated so it survives the card removal: keep the photo rail/pill as a standalone photo overlay on the map/photo surface (the map stage), NOT reintroducing the removed left/preview card. Confirm the exact current location by reading the return tree (the .vl-live-map-preview block near the photo rail) and the styled-jsx (.vl-live-photo-count, .vl-live-photo-shell, .vl-live-place-photos rules) before editing. Keep ALL markup INLINE in the component return (styled-jsx scoping gotcha) and preserve honest degradation and Google attribution.
steps: Read src/components/VayuLokLive.tsx return tree around the right column: the .vl-live-map-stage block that holds .vl-live-map-fallback, .vl-live-map-canvas, .vl-live-map-search, .vl-live-map-controls, and the .vl-live-map-preview card (the block guarded by `( previewAir || previewWeather || mapCandidate )`). Identify the photo rail subtree: .vl-live-photo-shell > .vl-live-photo-count (currently `{ displayPhotos.length } photos`) and .vl-live-place-photos with .vl-live-photo-page / .vl-live-place-photo figures, plus .vl-live-photo-tabs.

Requirement 02 - REMOVE the preview 'place card': delete the entire .vl-live-map-preview block (the place name head .vl-live-map-preview-head, .vl-live-map-preview-meta, .vl-live-preview-metrics, .vl-live-preview-insight, .vl-live-preview-scale, and the .vl-live-view-details button) and its CSS rules in styled-jsx (.vl-live-map-preview, ::after arrow, .vl-live-map-preview-head, .vl-live-map-address, .vl-live-map-preview-meta, .vl-live-preview-metrics, .vl-live-preview-cat, .vl-live-preview-insight, .vl-live-preview-scale, .vl-live-view-details, and their @media overrides at max-width:1023px/767px). Do NOT build any replacement left-side card now - that is a later task.

Preserve the photo rail as a standalone photo overlay: relocate .vl-live-photo-shell + .vl-live-place-photos + .vl-live-photo-tabs out of the removed .vl-live-map-preview card so they render as their own absolutely-positioned overlay inside .vl-live-map-stage (keep them INLINE in the return). Keep the existing photoRailRef, photoIndex scroll handling, photoPages logic, displayPhotos computation, and the photo-credit figcaptions (author attributions) intact. Keep the overlay inset from the map's bottom corners so Google's logo/legal stays visible (no change to the no-.gm-style-cc rule). If removing the preview card makes the photo overlay the only consumer of mapCandidate/previewPlace/previewWeather/previewAir, keep those state values that are still needed and remove only genuinely-unused ones so lint/typecheck stay clean (do not leave unused variables).

Requirement 01 - PILL becomes number-only + referee SVG on lime: change .vl-live-photo-count so its content is ONLY the numeric count (e.g. `{ displayPhotos.length }`) with NO word text ('photos' removed), rendered next to the exact referee-style SVG from the user instruction: `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" height="24px" viewBox="0 -960 960 960" width="24px" fill="#1f1f1f"><path d="M240-280v-120H120v-80h120v-120h80v120h120v80H320v120h-80Zm390 80v-438l-92 66-46-70 164-118h64v560h-90Z"/></svg>` (mark it aria-hidden="true" since it is decorative; keep an accessible label on the pill via aria-label describing the number, e.g. `${n} place photos`). The pill background must be the lime pill color already used on this page (var(--lime) #d1f470, matching the hero's #e0f7c8/lime system) - .vl-live-photo-count already uses rgba(209,244,112,.96); keep it a solid/opaque lime consistent with the page's lime pills and NO red. Keep the pill shape border-radius 999px.

Requirement 01 (photo background) - ensure the photo associated with the pill number sits on the SAME lime pill background: give the photo rail / photo cells a lime background behind the imagery (e.g. the .vl-live-place-photo / .vl-live-photo-page background becomes the lime tint used elsewhere, so when an image is loading or absent the lime shows through, matching the pill). Do not introduce any new non-palette color; reuse var(--lime)/var(--lime-tint)/#e0f7c8 as appropriate so it reads as the same lime as the pill. Keep rounded corners consistent with the page radii.

Update src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx so it reflects the new behavior and stays green: the existing suites assert heatmap-on-user-action, India-scoped autocomplete + placeFetchFields, honest degradation (zero fetch, absent .vl-live-map-canvas with no key), subscribe/contribute/share. If any assertion depended on the removed preview card text (e.g. place name in the preview, 'View details'/'Jump to details', or the '{n} photos' label), update it. Where meaningful, add/adjust an assertion that proves the pill now renders the numeric count without the 'photos' word and the preview place card is gone - but only assert on behavior the component actually renders in jsdom (the map/photo path requires the google stub and fetched data). Do not weaken the zero-fetch / degradation assertions.
Run npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run test and fix any failures introduced by the edits.
acceptance_criteria: The .vl-live-map-preview place card (name/metrics/insight/view-details button overlay) is entirely removed from both the return tree and the styled-jsx, with no replacement left-side card added.

The photo rail with its numeric pill still renders as a standalone overlay on the map/photo surface (not inside a reintroduced preview card) and remains inset from the map's bottom corners so Google attribution stays visible.

The pill (.vl-live-photo-count) renders ONLY the numeric number plus the exact provided referee SVG (height/width 24px, viewBox '0 -960 960 960', fill #1f1f1f, the exact path d), with the word 'photos' removed, on a lime pill background and with an accessible aria-label.
The photo associated with the pill number uses the same lime pill background color; no red or non-palette color is introduced.
`npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, and `npm run test` all pass with no unused-variable or dangling-reference errors.
The honest-degradation test (no key -> zero fetches, no .vl-live-map-canvas) still passes unchanged in intent.
